correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the normalized DFT on G=Z/(2N): with z_k=e^{pi ik/N}, half-window frequency Gram has diagonal 1/2, zero distinct same-parity entries, and opposite-parity centered block B_{ac}=(2/N) z_a/(z_a-z_c). Every z_k is distinct and Cauchy determinant shows every maximal r=min(e,o) square minor nonzero. Thus rank(B)=r, nullity of 2C-I is |e-o| and its other eigenvalues are paired singular values ±s_j. Cauchy–Binet gives exactly the stated positive product (2/N)^{2r} times the sum of squared Cauchy chord products. Balanced determinant sign is (-1)^r. N=1, r=0, unbalanced masks and all frequencies satisfy the stated boundary conventions. Independently built direct truncated DFT matrices for N=1..4 illustrative masks; spectral products matched chord sums to <4e-16. This finite check is not the proof.
residual_risks: The explicit gap factors can become ill-conditioned for large N, but the proof uses exact algebra, not floating tolerances.
This does not determine each individual off-center eigenvalue or unequal windows.
